svg.title: Saga (Orchestration)
svg.desc: Saga (Orchestration). A coordinator runs local transactions in sequence and triggers compensations when one fails. Step 1, Start the saga: The order starts as PENDING. The orchestrator sends Charge payment; Payments commits and replies ✓. Step 2, Next local transaction: The orchestrator sends Reserve stock; Inventory commits its own local transaction and replies ✓. Step 3, A step fails: Book shipment fails (no courier) and replies ✕. No global rollback: steps 1 and 2 are committed. Step 4, Compensate in reverse: Compensate in reverse order: Release stock, then Refund payment. The order ends CANCELLED.

g.text: The order starts as PENDING. The orchestrator sends Charge payment; Payments commits and replies ✓.
The orchestrator sends Reserve stock; Inventory commits its own local transaction and replies ✓.
Book shipment fails (no courier) and replies ✕. No global rollback: steps 1 and 2 are committed.
Compensate in reverse order: Release stock, then Refund payment. The order ends CANCELLED.
each step is one local transaction
✕ no global rollback: 1 and 2 stay committed
